Chelsea Gardens is where you can stay close to everything that moves Dubai, while finding the space to enjoy everything that makes life beautiful.

title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Project general facts Allegro Park is a true retreat of tranquility and luxury, where architecture meets the peaceful atmosphere of greenery and sea breezes on the Dubai Islands. This inspiring development offers residents the opportunity to enjoy unmatched serenity and harmony, just steps away from the shoreline yet surrounded by parks and nature. The meticulously designed residences feature panoramic windows that allow natural light to flood the interiors, while large balconies offer breathtaking views of nature and the coastline. The project offers a variety of luxurious amenities designed to enhance every aspect of island living, including unique beach-edge pools, a rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views, and an open-air cinema for unforgettable entertainment. Residents can maintain their wellness routine at the private fitness center and rejuvenate in the dedicated wellness area. Every communal space has been thoughtfully designed to create an atmosphere of tranquility and comfort, where every moment is filled with relaxation and joy. Each residence features a modern minimalist style with natural elements, creating an atmosphere of comfort and calm ideal for island living. The fully equipped kitchens feature modern appliances, while spacious rooms offer ample opportunity for personal customization. All residences are unfurnished, giving owners the creative freedom to create a space that reflects their individual preferences and style. Location description and benefits This prestigious development is situated on Dubai Islands, a visionary collection of man-made islands strategically located along the coast that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands offer a perfect blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city while allowing residents to enjoy the tranquility of island life. This prime location is just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes upscale amenities including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. The stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location make this a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of island serenity, urban accessibility, and sustainable living, offering an unmatched lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. description: Exclusive Sea-front Apartments with Installments on The Palm Jumeirah The Palm Jumeirah, an iconic landmark of Dubai, is a world-renowned man-made island shaped like a palm tree, offering unparalleled luxury and exclusivity. This architectural marvel is home to some of the most sought-after residential properties, five-star hotels, and fine dining destinations. With pristine beaches, panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline, and state-of-the-art amenities, The Palm Jumeirah perfectly combines serene waterfront living with urban convenience. Residents and visitors enjoy a vibrant lifestyle featuring high-end retail outlets, world-class entertainment, and recreational facilities, making it a global symbol of sophistication and modern luxury. Apartments for sale on The Palm Jumeirah, Dubai are located 15 minutes from JBR and Dubai Marina, 17 minutes from international schools and hospitals, 20 minutes from Mall of the Emirates, 25 minutes from Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, and 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is a stunning 76-floor architectural masterpiece located in the heart of Palm Jumeirah, designed to resemble organic seashells and ocean waves. This awe-inspiring tower features an exterior with sleek, sinuous curves that reflect the beauty of the sea and the natural environment, making it a standout landmark on Dubai's skyline. The buildings design integrates lush greenery, expansive terraces, and panoramic glass facades, offering breathtaking 180- or 360-degree views of the Arabian Gulf, Dubai skyline, Burj Al Arab, Burj Khalifa, and Ain Dubai. Amenities are thoughtfully curated to cater to a contemporary, ultra-luxurious lifestyle. These include a private sandy beach pool, a rooftop infinity pool on the 71st floor offering unparalleled 360-degree views, and beautifully landscaped recreational areas. Residents enjoy a dedicated 25-meter lap swimming pool, private pools for sky terrace apartments, childrens wet and dry play areas, paddle and squash courts, and a fully equipped gym, spa, and wellness center. Additional highlights are a private caf, lounge, and a business center with meeting rooms. Every residence has a private lift lobby, secure independent storage compartments, and access to concierge services. The project provides separate drivers quarters and generous parking provisions for convenience. The seamless integration of smart home technology and hotel-like services enhances everyday living, while a grand entrance lobby and world-class facilities redefine beachfront luxury. This vertical lake-inspired tower combines tranquility and opulence, offering residents a truly unique coastal living experience. The project offers meticulously designed 3-, 4-, and 5-bedroom residences that embody modern luxury and sophistication. The interiors feature expansive open layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flood the spaces and highlighting the elegant craftsmanship. Each residence is adorned with high-quality finishes, including premium marble flooring, custom cabinetry, and integrated lighting systems that enhance the ambiance. The kitchens are fully fitted with state-of-the-art white goods, sleek countertops, and spacious storage, making them both functional and stylish. Bedrooms come with fitted wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms featuring designer fixtures, double vanities, and rain showers for ultimate comfort. Vast terraces extend from the living spaces, providing seamless indoor-outdoor living and stunning views of lush greenery or private pools. Each home is equipped with smart home technology, private lift lobbies, and secure storage compartments, ensuring privacy and convenience. The interior design emphasizes both elegance and practicality, creating a serene sanctuary tailored for a contemporary, ultra-luxurious lifestyle. DXB-00189

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

Built around the concept of "A World of Amenities," the development brings together modern architecture, thoughtfully designed residences, and an extensive range of lifestyle facilities to create a vibrant residential experience. Its combination of community facilities, green surroundings, and urban accessibility makes it an attractive choice for both homeowners and property investors. Serenz brings together the advantages of this established community with an extensive collection of lifestyle amenities, fully furnished homes, and contemporary architecture, offering a distinctive approach to modern residential living.

title: WELCOME TO YOUR SAFTY HOME ENJOY AL FURJAN LIVING
description:
Imagine yourself living here...

Imagine opening your eyes and your balcony isn't a balcony. It's a private garden in the sky. Green plants wrapped around you, a big wicker egg chair, and soft fairy lights tangled in the leaves. No noise. No traffic. Just green, quiet, like you're in a resort.

You walk inside... It's fully furnished, premium finishes, everything is done. You walk into the bathroom and you feel like you walked into a spa. Marble, hidden LED glow under the sink, a big mirror, and a calm vibe that makes you forget you're in an apartment.

You go downstairs... The swimming pool is not a building pool, it's a resort. Sun deck, a cabana with woven pendant lights and golden glow, lit palm trees, and a space where you can sit with your family like you're on vacation every day.

Want to work out? The gym is not just a gym. It's floor-to-ceiling glass with the whole city in front of you, brand new equipment, and a quiet yoga area where you can breathe away from the world. Your kids have their own safe, closed play zone.

And at night? It's a whole different story. The pool glows blue, your balcony is full of golden lights, and the entire Dubai skyline lights up in front of you. Marina and JBR glowing in the background like you're watching a movie.

And the best part? You're in Al Furjan. That means the metro is at your doorstep. Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road are 2 minutes away. Marina is 10 minutes, Ibn Battuta Mall is 5 minutes, and all your work, schools, and life are around you. It's the most in-demand rental area in Dubai right now. Everyone wants to live here.

So whether you live in it and feel that resort life every day... or you rent it out and get a high rental yield because everyone is looking for this area... you win.

This is not an apartment... This is a full resort life, with interest-free installments, pre-launch prices, and limited units.

*Imagine yourself living it... before someone else takes it.*

description: Altus by Emaar is a contemporary residential development designed to bring together modern elegance, urban convenience, and sustainable living. Featuring thoughtfully designed residences and a distinctive architectural style, the development offers a refined lifestyle complemented by expansive views and well-planned living spaces. With an emphasis on natural light, functionality, and environmental responsibility, Altus presents a modern approach to comfortable city living. The development offers a selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, catering to individuals, couples, and families. The apartments are unfurnished, giving homeowners the flexibility to personalise their interiors according to their preferences. Sustainability is an integral part of the development's design. The surrounding community offers a blend of waterfront experiences, dining, retail, and recreational attractions, creating an appealing lifestyle for residents of different ages. Dubai Creek Harbour is also known for its ambitious architectural vision and connection to the historic Dubai Creek. Its combination of modern urban planning, waterfront scenery, and access to key destinations makes it attractive to both homeowners and investors seeking a contemporary address in Dubai. With its sustainable design features, modern interiors, and waterfront community setting, Altus by Emaar offers a distinctive residential experience that balances comfort, functionality, and contemporary elegance.

This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. The design emphasizes luxury and practicality, with concealed cisterns in bathrooms and carefully selected finishes throughout to enhance the overall living experience. UAQ-00004

description: Discover a lifestyle where the beauty of nature meets the energy of the city. Surrounded by tranquil creek views, striking skylines, and lush green landscapes, this exceptional residential destination offers a harmonious blend of serenity, contemporary design, and urban sophistication. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Creek Harbour is an ambitious waterfront destination that reflects Dubai's vision for innovative architecture, sustainable urban development, and exceptional lifestyle experiences. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, this master-planned community combines contemporary residences, landscaped open spaces, retail destinations, and leisure facilities along the historic Dubai Creek. One of the area's distinctive attractions is Creek Beach, an urban beach designed to bring a relaxed coastal atmosphere to the heart of the community. With approximately 700 metres of white sand, an infinity pool, and beautiful sunset views, it offers an inviting setting for families and residents to enjoy outdoor recreation and waterfront relaxation. The wider destination is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava as a landmark of architectural innovation. Together with the area's contemporary skyline, waterfront promenades, and carefully planned public spaces, these features contribute to its distinctive identity. Dubai Creek Harbour offers a lifestyle that combines scenic surroundings with convenient access to retail, dining, and leisure experiences. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Modern Waterfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a natural sanctuary renowned for its unspoiled white sand beaches, clear blue waters, and rich biodiversity, including mangroves that provide habitat for species such as flamingos, turtles, oryxes, and gazelles. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project is situated in a stunning island setting, blending refined waterfront elegance and lush natural beauty. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Towers A and B are semi-furnished, featuring the same premium built-in wardrobes and fully fitted kitchens, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces while enjoying core conveniences. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. Every detail has been crafted to reflect contemporary coastal elegance, offering residents a perfect balance between luxurious comfort and everyday practicality. UAQ-00010

The development located in Business Bay, Dubai, was conceived as an ultra-luxurious residential tower that asserts itself as one of the tallest and most exclusive housing structures in the world. The building features a striking architecture, inspired by the universe of high jewellery, which is reflected in sculptural shapes, metal inserts, worked decorative elements and meticulous attention to every aesthetic detail. The concept favours not only visual grandeur, but also the creation of sophisticated interiors, highly customisable and developed to offer a level of comfort and refinement rarely found in the residential market. The composition of the tower integrates different categories of housing, aimed at diversified profiles of residents. The initial typologies include two-and-a-half-bedroom residences, designed with functional layouts and a contemporary language, while always maintaining high standards of materials and finishes. Evolving in the range are three-bedroom units, which offer larger areas, harmoniously distributed rooms and rooms with large windows that allow unimpeded views of the Dubai skyline. On the upper levels, typologies of a frankly exclusive character emerge, such as the suspended mansions of four and six bedrooms, which occupy generous areas and provide a true experience of an independent house within a vertical tower. Some of these units include a private pool, cinema rooms, play areas, reading spaces and areas for wellness activities, such as rooms prepared for massages or fully equipped gyms. These residences are also distinguished by the high number of private parking spaces, which can vary between four and twelve, ensuring safety and practicality. The common areas have been carefully planned, using premium materials such as marble, worked metals and architectural lighting, creating an atmosphere of sophistication and exclusivity from the main atrium to the upper floors. WHERE EVERY DAY FEELS LIKE A GETAWAY

Imagine waking up in the heart of Dubai, where the city's vibrant energy meets the effortless spirit of coastal living.

The morning begins with sunlight pouring through floor-to-ceiling windows, illuminating warm interiors designed to make you feel instantly at home. You step out for an energising workout, take a refreshing swim, and let the day unfold at your own pace. This is more than a daily routine; it is a lifestyle shaped around freedom, comfort, and connection.

Welcome to The Elysian, in Jumeirah Gardens, where urban sophistication meets a beach-club-inspired atmosphere. Every detail invites you to experience the best of both worlds: the excitement of the city and the pleasure of having your own place to unwind.

As the afternoon arrives, the pool and sun deck become your escape. Perhaps you prefer a moment of tranquillity in the sauna and steam room, or an active afternoon in the indoor or outdoor gym. Later, gather with friends around the BBQ area, enjoy the rooftop lounge overlooking Dubai's skyline, or settle in for a movie beneath the stars at the outdoor cinema. With a kids' pool, cabanas, and a table tennis court, there is something to make every day more enjoyable.

Inside, contemporary design meets thoughtful functionality. Choose from studios and one-, two-, or three-bedroom residences, featuring warm earthy tones, elegant finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and carefully considered layouts. For an even more exclusive experience, selected residences feature private pools, bringing the feeling of a private retreat right to your doorstep.

And when you are ready to explore, Dubai is all around you. Jumeirah Beach, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and the city's most vibrant destinations are within convenient reach, with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road.

Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. description:
WHERE EVERY DAY FEELS LIKE A GETAWAY

Imagine waking up in the heart of Dubai, where the city's vibrant energy meets the effortless spirit of coastal living.

The morning begins with sunlight pouring through floor-to-ceiling windows, illuminating warm interiors designed to make you feel instantly at home. You step out for an energising workout, take a refreshing swim, and let the day unfold at your own pace. This is more than a daily routine; it is a lifestyle shaped around freedom, comfort, and connection.

Welcome to The Elysian, in Jumeirah Gardens, where urban sophistication meets a beach-club-inspired atmosphere. Every detail invites you to experience the best of both worlds: the excitement of the city and the pleasure of having your own place to unwind.

As the afternoon arrives, the pool and sun deck become your escape. Perhaps you prefer a moment of tranquillity in the sauna and steam room, or an active afternoon in the indoor or outdoor gym. Later, gather with friends around the BBQ area, enjoy the rooftop lounge overlooking Dubai's skyline, or settle in for a movie beneath the stars at the outdoor cinema. With a kids' pool, cabanas, and a table tennis court, there is something to make every day more enjoyable.

Inside, contemporary design meets thoughtful functionality. Choose from studios and one-, two-, or three-bedroom residences, featuring warm earthy tones, elegant finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and carefully considered layouts. For an even more exclusive experience, selected residences feature private pools, bringing the feeling of a private retreat right to your doorstep.

And when you are ready to explore, Dubai is all around you. Jumeirah Beach, Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and the city's most vibrant destinations are within convenient reach, with easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road.

description: We offer for sale a 2-room apartment with a rental contract, with an area of 88 m² , in the popular Zabeel area. The apartment is located in the new residential complex 1 Residences. It is fully renovated and equipped with furniture and appliances. The offered apartment is on a high floor, with a well-thought-out and convenient layout, a spacious balcony, and panoramic views of the park. The bright interior is designed in a modern style in cool tones with marble and tiles. The apartment has 1 parking space in the underground garage. Starting price - EUR 585,830. There is currently an annual rental contract with monthly payments. The current return is 5-6% per year. There is potential to increase profitability by renting the apartment short-term. About the project 1 Residences is a complex of two original towers in the shape of the number "1" in the historic district of Bur Dubai. The 43-storey buildings are elegantly connected at the top levels by a skybridge. Construction of the project was completed in 2022. Infrastructure On the podium level of the complex and the top three floors, public areas with landscaping and premium amenities have been created for residents and guests of 1 Residences. These include swimming pools with lounge areas, fountains, children's playgrounds, a modern gym, a 340-meter running track on the 43rd floor, and much more. The 1 Residences complex is located in Al Kifaf, near Dubai's popular historic district of Bur Dubai. The area includes many historic sites: the Dubai Museum in 18th-century style, the historic Al Bastakiya quarter, and more. The active residence of the Emir of Dubai, Zabeel Palace, is also located here. The district's special attractions include the grand viewing platform Dubai Frame and Zabeel Park. The park can be considered a huge green oasis. There you will find dinosaur sculptures, illuminated gardens, an ice park with children's rides, barbecue pavilions, and a running track with non-slip coating and aroma diffuser. All these locations are within a 5-10 minute drive from the complex. It takes five minutes by car to reach Dubai's main highway, Sheikh Zayed Road, which runs along the coast. This highway provides quick access to any location in Dubai, as well as to the neighboring emirates of Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. The apartments in 1 Residences appeal to lovers of luxury and active lifestyles who want to enjoy comfort in a modern residential complex with unique architecture. The strategic proximity to the center of Dubai, business districts, and the airport highlights the convenience of living in 1 Residences.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: WHERE LIFE OPENS TO A GREENER HORIZON
description:
There is something different about waking up to a view that gives you space to breathe.

No crowded skyline.
No sense of being surrounded.

Just open greens, natural light and a home that feels connected to a calmer side of Dubai.

This is Lawncrest, a contemporary residential destination in Dubai Production City, positioned at the edge of the community with sweeping views towards the greens of Jumeirah Golf Estates. Its architecture rises with a clean, modern character, while wide balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows bring the outdoors closer to everyday life.

But Lawncrest is designed for much more than beautiful views.

Imagine starting your morning with a quiet walk beneath the open sky, followed by an energising session at the outdoor gym or yoga lounge. When you want to push further, the fully equipped gym gives you your own private fitness rhythm.

Then comes the pool.

A place to slow down under the Dubai sun, while the kids enjoy their own pool and play spaces nearby. On weekends, the cabanas and BBQ lounge transform simple afternoons into gatherings with family and friends.

And when the sun goes down, Lawncrest reveals another side of itself.

A social games area brings people together. Outdoor seating creates the perfect setting for relaxed conversations. Then, as evening arrives, the outdoor cinema turns an ordinary night into something memorable — a movie beneath the open sky, surrounded by the calm of your community.

Even your everyday routine has been considered.

Smart-home features bring modern convenience into your residence, while EV charging facilities add a future-ready touch. With cafés, restaurants and essential services within the wider Dubai Production City community, daily life feels effortlessly connected.

And beyond Lawncrest, the city remains within reach.

Lawncrest is not simply a place to come home to.

It is a place to wake up inspired.

description:
WHEN THE FOREST BECOMES PART OF YOUR EVERYDAY LIFE

Imagine waking up in Dubai...

Not to the sound of traffic, not to concrete stretching endlessly across the horizon, but to a different kind of morning — one surrounded by trees, fresh air and the quiet feeling that nature is finally part of your everyday life.

This is the story of Lyra at Ghaf Woods.

Set within one of Dubai's most distinctive forest-inspired communities, Lyra introduces a new way of experiencing urban living. Here, your home doesn't simply stand within a neighbourhood. It becomes part of a landscape designed around greenery, movement, wellbeing and connection.

Step inside your residence and the feeling continues.

Contemporary interiors open towards natural light, creating a calm and elegant setting where the outside world feels beautifully close. Whether you choose a one- or two-bedroom residence, the spaces are designed for modern life while keeping a sense of warmth and privacy.

Then, instead of taking the elevator down into another concrete cityscape, you step outside into something different.

Walk beneath the trees.

Take your morning run along the trails.

Cycle through the landscape.

Pause beside the forest pools.

Let the children discover their own world through nature gardens and outdoor spaces, while you find a quiet moment for yourself at the wellness and yoga pavilion.

At Ghaf Woods, nature is not decoration.

It is the lifestyle.

And when you want to reconnect with the energy of Dubai, the city remains within easy reach, with Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road nearby.

Lyra is for those who want a home that feels different the moment they arrive — a place where mornings are calmer, evenings feel lighter and everyday life has room to breathe.

Because sometimes, the greatest luxury in a city like Dubai isn't being closer to everything.

It's having a place where you can finally slow down.

description:
Some homes offer an address. Others create a feeling that stays with you.

Le Château Piétrus is designed for the second kind of life.

Set on a first-row marina position at Dubai Islands, beside a landscaped park, it brings together the serenity of waterfront living and the refinement of a private European retreat. Only 86 fully furnished and serviced residences are arranged across seven residential floors, creating an intimate world where privacy, design and hospitality shape everyday life.

From the moment you enter, the experience feels different. Natural travertine, Italian Calacatta marble, curated European interiors and approximately 3.20-metre ceilings create a sense of warmth and space, while panoramic glazing opens the home towards the marina and park. Every residence is delivered turnkey, so you can step directly into a world designed around comfort and elegance.

The real story begins beyond your front door.

Imagine mornings in the Wellness Club, moving between Technogym fitness, Pilates, yoga and meditation before retreating into the hammam or sauna. Later, the pool and landscaped podium become your private escape, with refined cabanas and quiet gardens made for slow afternoons.

As evening arrives, life moves effortlessly towards the French brasserie, residents’ lounge bar or fire lounge. And when the city lights begin to shimmer across the water, residents can reserve the private Riva Dolceriva through the à la carte lifestyle programme with a professional captain, turning an ordinary evening into a sunset journey.

Concierge, valet and 24/7 security complete the experience.

This is more than a waterfront residence. It is a private world where European craftsmanship meets Dubai’s evolving island lifestyle.

Where the marina becomes your view.
Where hospitality becomes part of home.
Where every arrival feels like coming somewhere extraordinary.

Le Château Piétrus — a rare address for those who expect home to feel exceptional.

description:
WHERE THE CITY SLOWS DOWN, AND LIFE BEGINS TO FEEL DIFFERENT

There are places that simply put you close to the city.

And then there are places that let you experience the city without becoming overwhelmed by it.

West 5 Residences is designed for the second kind of life.

Imagine waking up in the heart of Dubai, with the energy of the city only moments away, yet your morning begins at a slower pace. Natural light fills your home, greenery softens the view, and the day starts with the feeling that everything you need is already within reach.

Set in Jumeirah Garden City, West 5 brings a refined residential atmosphere to one of Dubai's most connected urban locations. Its contemporary architecture and open, spacious residences create a home that feels modern without losing its sense of warmth.

Step outside and your day takes a different direction.

Take a refreshing swim. Begin your workout in the gym. Spend time surrounded by landscaped gardens. Let the children enjoy their own spaces while you unwind, gather with friends around the barbecue or simply take a quiet moment away from the city's rhythm.

And when you want the energy back, Dubai is waiting.

Downtown, Dubai Mall, DIFC and the city's iconic destinations remain within easy reach, while Jumeirah Garden City's central position keeps your everyday journey beautifully connected.

With elegant one- and two-bedroom residences, West 5 is created for people who want more from their address — more comfort, more connection, more balance and more meaning in the way they live.

Because the true luxury of living in Dubai is not being surrounded by everything.

It is knowing you can reach everything, while still having a place that feels entirely yours.

title: Emaar Oria
description: "Oria is a contemporary residential development by Emaar Properties located in Dubai Creek Harbour, adjacent to the Creek Beach district. The project comprises 163 residential units, offering one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments with total areas ranging from approximately 749 to 1,727 sq ft. The development features a waterfront-oriented setting with a creekside promenade and views of the district park and Creek Beach. Residents can enjoy access to recreational facilities, including children's play areas, an adventure playground, a cycling track, a skate park and sports courts, along with connections to public transportation, including an RTA ferry terminal and metro station. Starting prices are AED 1.7 million for one-bedroom apartments, AED 2.7 million for two-bedroom apartments and AED 3.7 million for three-bedroom apartments. The apartments feature balconies, while selected two-bedroom layouts include walk-in closets and the documented three-bedroom layouts offer walk-in closets, laundry rooms and study areas. Oria's location provides convenient access to key destinations across Dubai, with Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary approximately five minutes away, Downtown Dubai around 10 minutes away, Dubai International Airport approximately 15 minutes away and Al Maktoum International Airport around 35 minutes away. The development's staged payment plan extends from February 2024 through July 2028, incorporating construction-related milestones. Oria combines contemporary apartment living, recreational amenities and waterfront surroundings within the wider Dubai Creek Harbour community."

description:
WHERE ITALIAN ELEGANCE MEETS THE ART OF WATERFRONT LIVING

There are homes you enter, and there are residences that make you feel as though you have stepped into another world.

Welcome to Villa del Garda, a first-row waterfront residence on Dubai Islands, where the calm of the marina meets the timeless elegance of Italian design.

Imagine arriving home to an atmosphere created around beauty, comfort and effortless sophistication. Every residence is fully furnished and fully equipped, with bespoke Italian kitchens and custom-made Italian wardrobe systems crafted specifically for the project. European craftsmanship, refined materials and carefully selected interiors create a turnkey home where nothing feels added as an afterthought.

Then comes the view.

Beyond the elegant interiors, the marina opens before you, bringing the rhythm of the water into everyday life. Mornings begin with serene horizons, afternoons flow beside the infinity pool, and evenings become moments to remember as the sky changes colour above the Arabian Gulf.

The experience continues with a private clubhouse, fitness facilities, concierge and 24-hour security, while in-house golf carts make moving around the island effortless. For those who want to take luxury even further, à la carte services include a chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royce and a private Riva motorboat with captain, available for pre-booked experiences.

With residences ranging from refined apartments to exceptional duplexes and private terrace-pool residences, Villa del Garda offers a rare interpretation of waterfront living — intimate, serviced and unmistakably sophisticated.

Set on Dubai Islands, just minutes from the city's established destinations, this is where the energy of Dubai meets the serenity of the sea.

Villa del Garda is not simply a residence by the water. It is a private expression of Italian elegance, where every arrival feels special and every day carries the atmosphere of a five-star retreat.

raw_area: Dubai Land Residence Complex, Dubai, Dubai Dubai Land
description: Situated in DLRC next to Academic City, DLRC will be the prime Student Housing That will Pays 8-9% Gross Yields. Student rentals near Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) earn 8-9% gross yields. That's 2-3 points more than most of Dubai's residential market. It comes from four things working together: prices are low to buy, student demand is high, supply is short, and parents back the leases. Demand is much bigger than supply 27,000+ students across 26 universities, including Heriot-Watt, Amity, Middlesex, Wollongong and Canadian University Dubai Students come from 140+ countries, and most need private housing Fewer than 2,000 on-campus beds, which leaves 25,000+ students looking for rentals every year In short, far more tenants are looking than there are units, so rents stay firm and units don't sit empty for long. Long stays: undergraduates usually stay 3-4 years, and 75-85% renew Parents back the lease: 80%+ of international student leases carry a parental guarantee Fewer missed payments: 2-4% default or late payment, against 8-12% for young professionals Staff and faculty tenants: 2-3 year contracts give income all year round Handling the summer gap: Start leases in September, line up next year's tenants in March-April, and allow summer sublets. This keeps June-August vacancies low. Why DLRC beats Dubai Silicon Oasis 20-30% cheaper to buy, which adds about 1-1.5 points of yield straight away Rents as high or higher (AED 60-65K against 58-62K) Room to grow: DLRC is still an emerging area, so prices have more room to rise than in mature DSO Metro coming: the Academic City station on the Dubai Metro Blue

raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. description: Furnished Apartments with Burj Khalifa Views in Business Bay, Dubai Business Bay is a vibrant and upscale district in the heart of Dubai, known for its dynamic mix of luxury residential towers, high-end hotels, and premium office spaces. Strategically located along the Dubai Canal, it offers breathtaking skyline views, including the iconic Burj Khalifa. The area is a hub for business, leisure, and lifestyle, featuring world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options. With excellent connectivity via major highways and the metro, Business Bay attracts professionals, investors, and residents seeking a modern urban lifestyle with easy access to Downtown Dubai and other key destinations. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street. The apartments are just 4 minutes from Business Bay Metro Station, 5 minutes from Marasi Promenade, 9 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 11 minutes from Dubai Opera and Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. The project offers a modern and sophisticated living experience with an extensive array of luxurious amenities designed to enhance comfort and convenience. The exterior features a sleek, contemporary design with stunning views of the Dubai skyline. The building is equipped with an infinity pool, Jacuzzi, kids' pool, aquatic gym, and pool deck seating, complemented by a BBQ area, kids' play area, and a variety of sports facilities including a cricket pitch, trampoline arena, wall climbing, basketball court, and tennis/cricket training courts. A wellness club, beauty salon, kids' daycare, snooker zone, and library provide additional comfort and relaxation. The upper levels boast exclusive amenities such as a sky observatory deck, sky meditation area, and both indoor and outdoor party halls, with a rooftop featuring a golf simulator, arcade zone, and family seating. The development also includes a business centre, indoor gyms, jogging track, bowling center, and outdoor cinema, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle for its residents. The project features fully furnished 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each designed to offer a luxurious and contemporary living experience. The interiors are carefully curated with high-end finishes and attention to detail. The living spaces are spacious, with open layouts that seamlessly connect the living room, dining area, and kitchen, creating a perfect environment for relaxation and entertainment. Each apartment is equipped with fitted wardrobes in the bedrooms and kitchen white goods, including a refrigerator, cooker, and washing machine, ensuring ease and functionality. The modern kitchens are designed with sleek cabinetry and high-quality materials for a sophisticated look. Additionally, the apartments offer the option of private pools on the balcony, giving residents the opportunity to enjoy stunning views while experiencing the ultimate in privacy and luxury. The bathrooms are designed with premium fixtures and finishes, further elevating the overall living experience. With every detail meticulously planned, these apartments provide the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style for those looking to live in the heart of Dubai's vibrant Business Bay. description:
A HOME DESIGNED TO MAKE LIFE FEEL BEAUTIFUL

There is a moment when you walk into a home and everything simply feels right.

The light.
The proportions.
The softness of the details.
The way every space seems to understand how you want to live.

This is the feeling behind Sky Harmony.

Set in Jumeirah Village Circle, Sky Harmony is more than a contemporary residence. It is a vision of harmonious living, brought to life through the design philosophy of Natuzzi Italia, one of Italy's most recognised names in luxury furniture and design.

Imagine coming home after a long day in Dubai and entering a space shaped by Italian elegance. Soft forms, refined neutral tones, natural textures and carefully considered interiors create an atmosphere that feels sophisticated without ever becoming excessive.

Here, luxury does not need to announce itself.

It reveals itself quietly.

Step outside your residence and the story continues. Start your morning with a swim, recharge in the gym, take a peaceful run, or simply retreat into your private jacuzzi and let the day slow down. Spend time with the people you love around the kids' pool and play areas, challenge yourself at mini golf, or lose yourself in a book in the library.

And when evening arrives, the atmosphere changes once again.

The lights soften. The city begins to glow. You gather with friends, order a refreshing mocktail and settle beneath the open sky for an outdoor cinema experience.

For those who desire something even more exclusive, selected residences offer private jacuzzis, while the penthouse experience takes luxury higher with a private rooftop pool.

Every element has been composed around one idea: life should move beautifully.

Sky Harmony is where Italian design meets the rhythm of Dubai, where comfort meets sophistication, and where your home becomes more than a place to return to.

It becomes the place where your life finds its perfect harmony.

title: Old Town, Umm al-Quwain
description: Seafront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniya Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is an emerging residential and leisure destination renowned for its tranquil natural beauty and serene island atmosphere. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches, it provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, featuring exclusive residential communities, luxurious amenities, and diverse recreational options such as golfing, water sports, and eco-tourism activities. Its strategic position, away from the city's bustle yet conveniently accessible, makes it an ideal retreat for residents seeking tranquility combined with modern comfort. Apartments for sale on Siniya Island Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious coastal living experience, prominently featuring pristine natural beaches, serene lagoon beaches, and vibrant landscaped parks. Its exterior design is elegantly set along a mesmerizing shoreline with four distinct towers, each with breathtaking views of the turquoise waters and lush greenery. The community is enriched by world-class amenities including an infinity swimming pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, children's play areas, an outdoor cinema, and a community center. For adventure enthusiasts, thrilling water sports such as snorkeling, scuba diving, and kite surfing are readily available. Additional sophisticated conveniences include an exclusive yacht club, a vibrant retail boulevard with open-air cafés and gourmet dining options, an upscale shopping mall, and luxurious resorts. Connectivity is ensured by a picturesque 1.7 km bridge, providing easy access from the urban landscape to the island's tranquility. The project offers meticulously designed interiors that blend contemporary luxury with practical elegance, available in configurations of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Tower A residences are fully furnished, providing immediate comfort and sophisticated style from day one, while Towers B, C, and D are delivered semi-furnished, allowing residents flexibility to personalize their spaces. Each apartment is thoughtfully planned, featuring spacious layouts complemented by premium finishes and fixtures. All units come equipped with fitted wardrobes, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal, and modern kitchens fitted with high-quality white goods, enhancing convenience and elegance. Expansive windows and private balconies optimize natural lighting and allow residents to enjoy serene views of the surrounding natural landscapes, pristine beaches, and tranquil lagoons. The interiors encapsulate a refined lifestyle, with attention to detail evident in every corner, creating a harmonious environment tailored for ultimate comfort and style. UAQ-00006

description: Branded Luxury Apartments with Installments in Downtown Dubai Downtown Dubai is the city's vibrant flagship district, renowned for its iconic landmarks, world-class lifestyle, and unmatched investment appeal. Home to the majestic Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, and the captivating Dubai Fountain, it offers a perfect blend of luxury living, entertainment, and cultural experiences. With its premium residential towers, fine dining venues, designer boutiques, and direct connectivity to major business hubs, Downtown Dubai stands as the ultimate address for those seeking prestige, convenience, and a dynamic urban lifestyle. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street, 4 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 10 minutes from Dubai Opera, 12 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. Rising 71 stories above Dubai's iconic Sheikh Zayed Road, this architectural masterpiece is shaped as a gently curving prism inspired by desert winds, creating a striking landmark on the city skyline. Designed by the award-winning firm Arquitectonica with interiors by 1508 London, it blends minimalist sophistication with refined Italian elegance. Residents enjoy an array of world-class amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, a state-of-the-art Technogym fitness center, yoga and Pilates rooms, a golf simulator, and a holistic spa featuring steam, sauna, salt, and oxygen rooms. Additional luxuries include a private salon, events space, Bellini Bar, cinema, library, billiards and media rooms, podcast and art studios, a kids' club, and a refrigerated delivery area. Services are equally exceptional, offering 24-hour valet, doorman, security, concierge-style assistance, private dining by a Bellini chef, and bespoke lifestyle management, ensuring an elevated living experience enriched with Cipriani's renowned hospitality. The project offers an exquisite selection of 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, fully fitted and thoughtfully crafted to embody timeless elegance and modern sophistication. Designed by the renowned studio 1508 London, the interiors are a contemporary interpretation of classic design, enriched with premium finishes, bespoke Italian kitchens, fitted wardrobes, and top-tier kitchen white goods. Apartments are delivered without soft furniture but come complete with refined elements such as curtains, wallpapers, and curated design details that elevate each space. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows fill the interiors with natural light, while high ceilings and open layouts create a sense of grandeur. The master bedrooms serve as serene retreats, featuring custom Italian vanities, luxurious bathtubs, and elegant shower enclosures. Every apartment seamlessly blends form and function, offering a sanctuary of comfort enhanced by breathtaking views of Downtown Dubai, the Arabian Gulf, and the iconic Burj Khalif. DXB-00283

description: Discover an exceptional waterfront lifestyle where architectural brilliance meets contemporary luxury. Rising above Dubai Harbour, this prestigious residential development by Sobha Group presents an exclusive collection of one, two, and three-bedroom apartments across three striking towers, with the tallest reaching 67 storeys. Designed to capture breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai's iconic skyline, the residences offer a sophisticated blend of elevated living, refined design, and premium lifestyle experiences. Every residence showcases meticulous craftsmanship and carefully selected materials. Expansive floor-to-ceiling double-glazed glass façades invite natural light into the interiors, while generous three-metre ceiling heights enhance the sense of space and openness. Extra-large porcelain tiles, pre-engineered timber flooring, contemporary carpeting, elegant veneer-finished doors, and thoughtfully designed wardrobes create a harmonious balance of texture and sophistication. Smart home automation, discreet architectural lighting, and elegant linear air diffusers further enhance the modern living experience. The kitchens are designed to combine visual elegance with everyday practicality, featuring fully fitted layouts, premium Miele appliances, and marble or solid-surface countertops. Integrated smart-home technology and state-of-the-art appliances bring added convenience, while carefully curated finishes maintain a consistent standard of quality throughout each residence. Complemented by an impressive collection of lifestyle amenities, the development offers residents an elevated residential experience defined by panoramic views, sophisticated interiors, and the distinctive atmosphere of waterfront living. Every detail reflects a commitment to craftsmanship, comfort, and contemporary elegance. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Harbour is a prestigious waterfront destination positioned between Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island, offering an exceptional combination of coastal scenery, leisure experiences, and convenient city access. Set along Dubai's shoreline, the district brings together residential living, hospitality, dining, retail, and world-class maritime facilities within a distinctive seafront environment. One of the area's defining features is its impressive marina and advanced cruise terminal, which contribute to its position as a prominent destination for yachting and cruise tourism. Residents can enjoy proximity to beautiful beaches, waterfront promenades, premium dining venues, and renowned attractions, including Ain Dubai and Burj Al Arab. The surrounding coastal landscape creates an inviting setting for those who appreciate the energy of the city alongside the tranquillity of the sea. Connectivity is another key advantage. Direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road provides convenient connections to major districts across Dubai, including Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and the wider commercial and entertainment hubs. The location also offers access to both Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport, with actual journey times varying according to traffic and route conditions. With its distinctive waterfront setting, marina lifestyle, and proximity to some of Dubai's most recognised destinations, Dubai Harbour offers a compelling address for residents seeking a sophisticated coastal lifestyle connected to the wider city.

description: Azizi Wasel is a contemporary waterfront residential development on Dubai Islands, offering an exceptional collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, alongside exclusive four-bedroom penthouses. Defined by sleek architectural lines, expansive glass façades, and thoughtfully designed open spaces, the development embraces natural light and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and Dubai skyline further enhance its appeal, creating a sophisticated residential environment where modern design meets coastal tranquillity. The development offers a carefully selected range of amenities designed to complement a relaxed yet active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a fully equipped modern gym, landscaped gardens, and a multipurpose hall for community gatherings and social events. On-site retail outlets provide convenient access to everyday essentials, while dedicated children's play areas create a welcoming environment for families. Every feature is designed to balance leisure, convenience, and community living within an attractive waterfront setting. The interiors showcase contemporary design, quality materials, and refined finishes, creating comfortable and functional living spaces. Equipped kitchens add everyday practicality, while well-planned layouts maximise space and natural light. The residences are delivered unfurnished, giving homeowners the freedom to personalise their interiors while enjoying modern specifications and the appeal of waterfront living. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an ambitious coastal destination designed to bring together waterfront residences, leisure attractions, hospitality, and contemporary urban living. Comprising five interconnected islands, the master development features a distinctive blend of residential neighbourhoods, pristine beaches, landscaped spaces, and recreational destinations. Its coastal setting offers residents the opportunity to embrace a more relaxed lifestyle, complemented by scenic sea views and an atmosphere of seaside exclusivity. Connected to mainland Dubai through established road infrastructure, Dubai Islands combines the tranquillity of island living with access to the city's established commercial and lifestyle destinations. Residents can enjoy convenient connectivity to areas such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah, while the surrounding district continues to develop as a destination for waterfront leisure and hospitality. Planned attractions include upscale hotels, fine-dining restaurants, retail destinations, beach clubs, and recreational facilities, creating a vibrant environment for residents and visitors alike. Designed to offer a diverse lifestyle experience, Dubai Islands brings together peaceful residential settings and lively leisure destinations within one coastal masterplan. Its emphasis on landscaped environments, modern infrastructure, and integrated amenities contributes to its long-term appeal as a distinctive waterfront address. Combining coastal scenery, urban accessibility, and a growing selection of lifestyle attractions, Dubai Islands presents an appealing choice for those seeking a contemporary seaside lifestyle in Dubai.
