title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

description:
WHERE THE LAGOON BECOMES PART OF HOME
 

Some homes give you a beautiful view.

Others give you a completely different way of living.

Lunaya Terraces belongs to the second kind.

Set within the nature-led world of Lunaya in Jebel Ali, this refined collection of low-rise residences brings a new expression of waterfront living to Dubai. Here, architecture rises gently around water, gardens and open skies, creating a home that feels connected to nature from every angle.

The experience begins with the terraces.

Generous private outdoor spaces extend the living room beyond its walls, while floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light deep into the interiors. With one-, two- and three-bedroom residences, Lunaya Terraces combines contemporary elegance with the openness and privacy usually associated with villa living.

Then there is the landscape.

A remarkable 900,000 sq. ft. of swimmable lagoons forms the heart of Lunaya, surrounded by greenery and connected through walking and cycling routes. Around the terraces, the lifestyle unfolds through rooftop pools, wellness spaces, fitness facilities, gardens, children's areas, sports courts, cafés and everyday conveniences.

Imagine starting your morning with sunlight across your terrace.

A swim beside the lagoon.

An afternoon spent between wellness and greenery.

And an evening where the water becomes the backdrop to everything.

This is the beauty of Lunaya Terraces.

Not apartment living as you know it.

A more open, more natural and more refined way to experience home.

Where the terrace becomes your outdoor room.
Where the lagoon becomes your horizon.
And where every day feels beautifully connected to nature.

description: Volta by DAMAC Properties is a premium residential development situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering an exceptional blend of contemporary architecture, urban sophistication, and upscale living. The development features a diverse collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments alongside super-luxury three- and four-bedroom residences, catering to a range of lifestyle preferences. Designed to complement Dubai's dynamic cityscape, the tower combines elegant residential spaces with modern functionality, further enhanced by a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure for added convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully curated lifestyle with dedicated recreational spaces and leisure amenities, including a rooftop amenity area atop the separate podium parking structure. Its prime Downtown Dubai location places residents within easy reach of prestigious shopping destinations, fine dining establishments, entertainment venues, and renowned cultural landmarks. This combination of urban connectivity, premium facilities, and contemporary residential design creates an appealing living environment for those seeking a sophisticated city lifestyle. The interiors are finished with carefully selected materials and contemporary detailing to create a refined and functional living experience. Living and dining areas feature elegant marble flooring, painted walls, and selected accent finishes, while bedrooms incorporate porcelain tile flooring, built-in wardrobes, and thoughtfully designed feature walls in the master bedroom. Bathrooms are appointed with stone countertops, quality sanitary ware, mirrors, shower enclosures, and modern fittings. Kitchens feature sleek cabinetry, stone countertops, stainless-steel sinks, porcelain flooring, and integrated appliances, including a cooker, extractor hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. Delivered unfurnished, the residences provide a premium finished foundation that allows homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their individual tastes. Location Description and Benefits Downtown Dubai is one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant destinations, renowned for its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the spectacular Dubai Fountain, the district offers an exceptional combination of luxury shopping, fine dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Its dynamic environment attracts residents and visitors throughout the year, making it one of Dubai's most recognisable lifestyle and residential destinations. The neighbourhood offers a sophisticated urban lifestyle, with an extensive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, stylish cafés, and high-end leisure destinations. Beyond its commercial appeal, Downtown Dubai provides a vibrant residential environment where everyday conveniences and entertainment are seamlessly integrated. From designer boutiques and international restaurants to scenic promenades and lively public spaces, the district caters to those who appreciate a connected and contemporary way of living. Strategically positioned near Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Al Wasl, and Business Bay, Downtown Dubai benefits from excellent connectivity to key commercial districts, residential communities, and major destinations across the city. Its accessible transport links and proximity to essential amenities make it particularly attractive to professionals, frequent travellers, and residents seeking convenient urban living. Combining a prestigious address, landmark surroundings, and a thriving lifestyle scene, Downtown Dubai continues to stand out as one of the city's most desirable destinations for luxury residential living.

title: DIFC Heights Tower
description:
DIFC Heights Tower is the second residential development from Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), following DIFC Living. The mixed-use tower stands on Al Mostaqbal Street in DIFC (Dubai International Financial Centre), between Index Tower and DAMAC Park Towers, and rises to ground plus 47 floors, with 32 residential floors and seven commercial floors. Its 366 homes range from one-bedroom apartments of 871 sq ft to four-bedroom duplexes of 3,618 sq ft, with two- and three-bedroom apartments and three-bedroom duplexes in between.

Interiors use pastel tones, high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glazing, and the homes are semi-furnished, with Bosch kitchen appliances in the apartments and Miele in the duplexes. Shared facilities include a gym, a temperature-controlled swimming pool, a separate kids' pool, a family lounge, an indoor kids' play area, a multipurpose hall and a co-working space, alongside landscaped terraces at the podium and amenity levels. The tower opens onto Gate Avenue at both ground and podium level, a Dubai Metro station is about five minutes on foot, Burj Khalifa and the Museum of the Future are around five minutes by car, and Dubai International Airport is roughly 20 minutes away.

DIFC is home to more than 46,000 professionals working across over 6,900 registered companies, so the homes sit close to a large and established workforce. The developer is the financial centre itself, and the building combines residences with offices and retail in a single address. The payment plan is 5% on booking, 65% during construction and 30% on handover, with completion expected in Q4 2029.

description: Project general facts This is a contemporary residential development inspired by the timeless elegance of French architecture, where refined design meets modern comfort in a harmonious living environment. Thoughtfully crafted with graceful proportions, clean architectural lines, and beautifully landscaped surroundings, the project creates a peaceful sanctuary that balances sophistication with everyday functionality. Spacious residences are filled with natural light through open-plan layouts and expansive windows, offering bright, elegant interiors designed to foster comfort, tranquility, and a true sense of home. Residents enjoy a carefully curated collection of amenities that promote wellness, relaxation, and family living. Landscaped green spaces, walking paths, tranquil courtyards, a contemporary fitness center, meditation and recovery areas, and dedicated children's play zones create a vibrant community where every generation can thrive. Every element has been designed to encourage an active, balanced lifestyle while providing peaceful spaces for connection, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. The residences feature modern interiors finished with high-quality materials, elegant detailing, and integrated smart home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Bright open spaces, bespoke storage solutions, and refined finishes create a timeless living environment that combines style with practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while the residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering built-in furniture and essential interior elements that provide the perfect foundation for personalized living. Location description and benefits Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors. In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings. Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai. title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

description: Reference: GTWW-T1215. Discover a new residential icon in the heart of Dubai, a 450-metre-tall, 109-storey tower that redefines the concept of living above the city. Situated on the prestigious Sheikh Zayed Road, this development elevates the urban experience by combining architectural elegance, endless views, and a direct connection to the city's most relevant areas. Just minutes from Business Bay, DIFC, Downtown and Jumeirah Beach, it offers a prime location that ensures mobility, convenience and the possibility of living in the centre of it all. The building comprises 684 residences, spread between one- to four-bedroom apartments and exclusive duplexes, each designed as a tranquil refuge elevated above the urban hustle and bustle. Floor-to-ceiling windows open onto the sea and skyline, providing abundant natural light and a continuous sense of spaciousness. Private balconies extend this connection to the landscape, while interior finishes including porcelain floors, fully equipped kitchens with appliances from recognised brands and bathrooms with premium materials guarantee comfort, quality and sophistication in every detail. The integrated technology allows you to control light and air conditioning, transforming each residence into a modern and functional space. The tower also stands out for its four sky-parks, distributed vertically and created to offer distinct worlds suspended in the air. The first is dedicated to family energy, with leisure spaces, activities for children, play areas and sports areas that promote moments of conviviality. The second focuses on well-being, with three levels that bring together a running track, training areas, yoga areas and garden terraces, creating perfect environments for both physical activity and moments of leisure. The third is a quiet refuge full of vegetation, sensory paths, glass pavilions and quiet corners that invite reading, reflection and rest. The room, situated at about 370 meters high, offers a suspended resort atmosphere, with an infinity pool, floating deck and spaces intended to relax while the horizon lights up with the sunset. The experience begins right in the lobby, a space designed to convey serenity and grandeur through the careful use of stone, wood and metal elements that filter light in a gentle way, creating a feeling of warmth even before entering the house. title: Dubai Maritime City, Dubai
description: Shahrukhz Residences is a waterfront residential tower inspired by Shah Rukh Khan and built around the idea of living life king style. A sculpted façade with flowing curves and warm metallic accents rises above the sea, while every level is oriented towards open water and the city skyline. The collection spans studios and flexible studios, one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, King's layouts with signature dressing areas, and a separate wing of Ocean Residences with larger suites set closer to the water. Residents enjoy an extensive programme of amenities spread across a lifestyle deck, a wellness deck and a sky deck. The podium brings together a children's water park, a dancing fountain, padel, basketball and cricket courts, cabanas, a sensory garden and barbecue areas. A wellness floor features an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym and a longevity lounge with cryotherapy, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, red light therapy and a salt room, while indoor spaces include a private cinema, a podcast studio, a business centre, a dance studio, a golf simulator and a kids' play area, crowned by a rooftop clubhouse and outdoor deck. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with floor-to-ceiling glazing that frames uninterrupted sea views. Thoughtful planning adds convertible layouts, multipurpose rooms, dual-access bathrooms and dedicated laundry areas in selected homes, while King's units include generous wardrobe and dressing suites finished in refined, light-toned materials. Location description and benefits Dubai Maritime City is a waterfront district on a man-made peninsula between Port Rashid and the historic heart of Bur Dubai. The district is shaped as a lifestyle destination by the sea, close to Port Rashid, the Dubai Cruise Terminal, Dubai World Trade Centre and Jumeirah Beach. The peninsula connects quickly to Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, while Dubai International Airport and Palm Jumeirah remain within easy reach. The community plan includes a planned metro station, a proposed shopping mall, a beach, a sunset promenade, a sports park, a cable car, a sky walk bridge and a mosque, adding everyday convenience along the water. Waterfront living close to the main business and tourism hubs of Dubai continues to attract professionals, families and holiday renters. Dubai Maritime City combines this appeal with its central coastal position and growing community infrastructure, supporting steady demand for both long-term rentals and premium short-stay homes.

description: Branded Luxury Apartments with Installments in Downtown Dubai Downtown Dubai is the city's vibrant flagship district, renowned for its iconic landmarks, world-class lifestyle, and unmatched investment appeal. Home to the majestic Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall, and the captivating Dubai Fountain, it offers a perfect blend of luxury living, entertainment, and cultural experiences. With its premium residential towers, fine dining venues, designer boutiques, and direct connectivity to major business hubs, Downtown Dubai stands as the ultimate address for those seeking prestige, convenience, and a dynamic urban lifestyle. are strategically located with access to Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road, Al-A'amal Street, and Al Asayel Street, 4 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 7 minutes from The Dubai Fountain, 10 minutes from Dubai Opera, 12 minutes from Museum of The Future, 14 minutes from Coca-Cola arena, 16 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 24 minutes from Jumeirah Beach Residence and Dubai Marina, 35 minutes from Al Maktoum International Airport. Services are equally exceptional, offering 24-hour valet, doorman, security, concierge-style assistance, private dining by a Bellini chef, and bespoke lifestyle management, ensuring an elevated living experience enriched with Cipriani's renowned hospitality. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows fill the interiors with natural light, while high ceilings and open layouts create a sense of grandeur. The master bedrooms serve as serene retreats, featuring custom Italian vanities, luxurious bathtubs, and elegant shower enclosures. Every apartment seamlessly blends form and function, offering a sanctuary of comfort enhanced by breathtaking views of Downtown Dubai, the Arabian Gulf, and the iconic Burj Khalif. DXB-00283
